verses.original: וַיָּ֣שֶׁב אֹתִ֗י דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַֽחִיצ֔וֹן שַׁ֤עַר הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ הַפֹּנֶ֖ה קָדִ֑ים וְה֖וּא סָגֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šeḇ ’ō·ṯî de·reḵ ha·ḥî·ṣō·wn ša·‘ar ham·miq·dāš hap·pō·neh qā·ḏîm wə·hū sā·ḡūr
verses.literal: The man then brought me back - to the outer gate of the sanctuary that faced east but it was shut

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜י הַזֶּה֩ הַשַּׁ֣עַר יִהְיֶ֜ה סָג֨וּר לֹ֣א יִפָּתֵ֗חַ לֹא־ וְאִישׁ֙ יָ֣בֹא ב֔וֹ כִּ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣א ב֑וֹ וְהָיָ֖ה סָגֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lay haz·zeh haš·ša·‘ar yih·yeh sā·ḡūr lō yip·pā·ṯê·aḥ lō- wə·’îš yā·ḇō ḇōw kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- yiś·rā·’êl bā ḇōw wə·hā·yāh sā·ḡūr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to me This gate is to remain shut It shall not be opened and no man shall enter through it because the LORD the God of Israel has entered through it Therefore it will remain shut

verses.original: אֶֽת־ הַנָּשִׂ֗יא נָ֥שִׂיא ה֛וּא יֵֽשֶׁב־ בּ֥וֹ לֶאֱכָול־ לֶ֖חֶם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה יָב֔וֹא מִדֶּ֨רֶךְ אֻלָ֤ם הַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ יֵצֵֽא׃ וּמִדַּרְכּ֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- han·nā·śî nā·śî hū yê·šeḇ- bōw le·’ĕ·ḵō·wl- lɛ·ḥɛm lip̄·nê Yah·weh yā·ḇō·w mid·de·reḵ ’u·lām haš·ša·‘ar yê·ṣê ū·mid·dar·kōw
verses.literal: - Only the prince . . . himself may sit inside the gateway to eat . . . in the presence of the LORD He must enter by way of the portico of the gateway and go out the same way

verses.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֜נִי אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַבַּיִת֒ דֶּֽרֶךְ־ הַצָּפוֹן֮ שַׁ֣עַר וָאֵ֕רֶא וְהִנֵּ֛ה כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מָלֵ֥א יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֣ית וָאֶפֹּ֖ל אֶל־ פָּנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇî·’ê·nî ’el- pə·nê hab·ba·yiṯ de·reḵ- haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ša·‘ar wā·’ê·re wə·hin·nêh ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh ’eṯ- mā·lê Yah·weh bêṯ wā·’ep·pōl ’el- pā·nāy
verses.literal: Then the man brought me to the front of the temple by way of the north gate I looked and saw the glory of the LORD - filling His temple and I fell facedown . . .

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֗ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜י בֶּן־ אָדָ֡ם שִׂ֣ים לִבְּךָ֩ וּרְאֵ֨ה בְעֵינֶ֜יךָ שְּׁמָ֗ע אֵ֣ת וּבְאָזְנֶ֣יךָ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אֹתָ֔ךְ לְכָל־ חֻקּ֥וֹת וּלְכָל־ תּוֹרֹתוֹ בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ לִבְּךָ֙ לִמְב֣וֹא הַבַּ֔יִת בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹצָאֵ֥י הַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ben- ’ā·ḏām śîm lib·bə·ḵā ū·rə·’êh ḇə·‘ê·ne·ḵā šə·mā‘ ’êṯ ū·ḇə·’ā·zə·ne·ḵā kāl- ’ă·šer ’ă·nî mə·ḏab·bêr ’ō·ṯāḵ lə·ḵāl ḥuq·qō·wṯ ū·lə·ḵāl- tō·rō·ṯō bêṯ- Yah·weh wə·śam·tā lib·bə·ḵā lim·ḇō·w hab·ba·yiṯ bə·ḵōl mō·w·ṣā·’ê ham·miq·dāš
verses.literal: The LORD said to me Son of man pay attention . . . look carefully with your eyes and listen closely - with your ears to everything - I tell you concerning all the statutes and laws of the house of the LORD Take careful note . . . of the entrance to the temple along with all the exits of the sanctuary

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֶל־ מֶ֙רִי֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה אָמַ֖ר רַב־ לָכֶ֛ם מִֽכָּל־ תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’el- me·rî ’el- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kōh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar raḇ- lā·ḵem mik·kāl tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Tell . . . the rebellious . . . house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says I have had enough of all your abominations O house of Israel

verses.original: אֶ֖ל כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃ בַּהֲבִיאֲכֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי־ נֵכָ֗ר עַרְלֵי־ לֵב֙ וְעַרְלֵ֣י בָשָׂ֔ר לִהְי֥וֹת בְּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י לְחַלְּל֣וֹ אֶת־ בֵּיתִ֑י בְּהַקְרִֽיבְכֶ֤ם אֶת־ לַחְמִי֙ חֵ֣לֶב וָדָ֔ם וַיָּפֵ֙רוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֔י
verses.transliteration: ’el kāl- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem ba·hă·ḇî·’ă·ḵem bə·nê- nê·ḵār ‘ar·lê- lêḇ wə·‘ar·lê ḇā·śār lih·yō·wṯ bə·miq·dā·šî lə·ḥal·lə·lōw ’eṯ- bê·ṯî bə·haq·rî·ḇə·ḵem ’eṯ- laḥ·mî ḥê·leḇ wā·ḏām way·yā·p̄ê·rū ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî
verses.literal: In addition to all your other abominations you brought in foreigners . . . uncircumcised in both heart . . . and flesh to occupy My sanctuary you defiled - My temple when you offered - My food the fat and the blood you broke - My covenant

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת קָדָשָׁ֑י וַתְּשִׂימ֗וּן לְשֹׁמְרֵ֧י מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֛י בְּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō šə·mar·tem miš·me·reṯ qā·ḏā·šāy wat·tə·śî·mūn lə·šō·mə·rê miš·mar·tî bə·miq·dā·šî lā·ḵem
verses.literal: And you have not kept charge of My holy things but have appointed others to keep charge of My sanctuary for you

verses.original: כֹּה־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ אָמַר֮ כָּל־ בֶּן־ נֵכָ֗ר עֶ֤רֶל לֵב֙ וְעֶ֣רֶל בָּשָׂ֔ר לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא אֶל־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֑י לְכָל־ בֶּן־ נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֕ר בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ā·mar kāl- ben- nê·ḵār ‘e·rel lêḇ wə·‘e·rel bā·śār lō yā·ḇō·w ’el- miq·dā·šî lə·ḵāl ben- nê·ḵār ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says No foreigner . . . uncircumcised in heart . . . and flesh - may enter . . . My sanctuary . . . not even a foreigner . . . who lives among the Israelites . . .

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָֽחֲקוּ֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בִּתְע֤וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּע֣וּ מֵֽעָלַ֔י אַחֲרֵ֖י גִּלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֑ם וְנָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- hal·wî·yim ’ă·šer rā·ḥă·qū mê·‘ā·lay yiś·rā·’êl biṯ·‘ō·wṯ ’ă·šer tā·‘ū mê·‘ā·lay ’a·ḥă·rê gil·lū·lê·hem wə·nā·śə·’ū ‘ă·wō·nām
verses.literal: Surely . . . the Levites who wandered away from Me when Israel went astray and who wandered away from Me after their idols will bear the consequences of their iniquity

verses.original: וְהָי֤וּ מְשָׁ֣רְתִ֔ים בְמִקְדָּשִׁי֙ פְּקֻדּוֹת֙ אֶל־ שַׁעֲרֵ֣י הַבַּ֔יִת וּֽמְשָׁרְתִ֖ים אֶת־ הַבָּ֑יִת הֵ֠מָּה יִשְׁחֲט֨וּ אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֤ה וְאֶת־ הַזֶּ֙בַח֙ לָעָ֔ם וְהֵ֛מָּה יַעַמְד֥וּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֖ם לְשָֽׁרְתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū mə·šā·rə·ṯîm ḇə·miq·dā·šî pə·qud·dō·wṯ ’el- ša·‘ă·rê hab·ba·yiṯ ū·mə·šā·rə·ṯîm ’eṯ- hab·bā·yiṯ hêm·māh yiš·ḥă·ṭū ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- haz·ze·ḇaḥ lā·‘ām wə·hêm·māh ya·‘am·ḏū lip̄·nê·hem lə·šā·rə·ṯām
verses.literal: Yet they shall be ministers in My sanctuary [having] charge of the gates of the temple and ministering - [there] They shall slaughter - the burnt offerings - and other sacrifices for the people . . . and stand before them to minister to them

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשָׁרְת֤וּ אוֹתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י גִלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְמִכְשׁ֣וֹל עָוֺ֑ן לְבֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל־ כֵּן֩ נָשָׂ֨אתִי יָדִ֜י עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם וְנָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָֽם׃ נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ’ă·šer yə·šā·rə·ṯū ’ō·w·ṯām lip̄·nê ḡil·lū·lê·hem wə·hā·yū lə·miḵ·šō·wl ‘ā·wōn lə·ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ‘al- kên nā·śā·ṯî yā·ḏî ‘ă·lê·hem wə·nā·śə·’ū ‘ă·wō·nām nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Because - they ministered - before their idols and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel therefore . . . I swore with an uplifted hand concerning them that they would bear the consequences of their iniquity declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלַי֙ לְכַהֵ֣ן לִ֔י וְלָגֶ֙שֶׁת֙ עַל־ כָּל־ קָ֣דָשַׁ֔י אֶל־ קָדְשֵׁ֖י הַקְּדָשִׁ֑ים וְנָֽשְׂאוּ֙ כְּלִמָּתָ֔ם וְתוֹעֲבוֹתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yig·gə·šū ’ê·lay lə·ḵa·hên lî wə·lā·ḡe·šeṯ ‘al- kāl- qā·ḏā·šay ’el- qā·ḏə·šê haq·qə·ḏā·šîm wə·nā·śə·’ū kə·lim·mā·ṯām wə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯām ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: They must not approach Me to serve Me as priests or come near . . . any of My holy things . . . or the most holy things . . . They will bear the shame of the abominations - they have committed

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֔ם שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת לְכֹל֙ עֲבֹ֣דָת֔וֹ הַבָּ֑יִת וּלְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה בּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’ō·w·ṯām šō·mə·rê miš·me·reṯ lə·ḵōl ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw hab·bā·yiṯ ū·lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer yê·‘ā·śeh bōw
verses.literal: Yet I will appoint them to keep charge of all the work for the temple and everything - to be done in it

verses.original: הַלְוִיִּ֜ם וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים בְּנֵ֣י צָד֗וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁמְר֜וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת מִקְדָּשִׁי֙ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בִּתְע֤וֹת מֵֽעָלַ֔י הֵ֛מָּה יִקְרְב֥וּ אֵלַ֖י לְשָֽׁרְתֵ֑נִי וְעָמְד֣וּ לְפָנַ֗י לְהַקְרִ֥יב לִי֙ חֵ֣לֶב וָדָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hal·wî·yim wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm bə·nê ṣā·ḏō·wq ’ă·šer šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ miq·dā·šî bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl biṯ·‘ō·wṯ mê·‘ā·lay hêm·māh yiq·rə·ḇū ’ê·lay lə·šā·rə·ṯê·nî wə·‘ā·mə·ḏū lə·p̄ā·nay lə·haq·rîḇ lî ḥê·leḇ wā·ḏām nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: But the Levitical priests who are descended from Zadok and who kept - charge of My sanctuary when the Israelites . . . went astray from Me . . . are to approach Me to minister before Me They will stand before Me to offer Me fat and blood declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: הֵ֜מָּה יָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֗י וְהֵ֛מָּה יִקְרְב֥וּ אֶל־ שֻׁלְחָנִ֖י לְשָׁרְתֵ֑נִי וְשָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמַרְתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- miq·dā·šî wə·hêm·māh yiq·rə·ḇū ’el- šul·ḥā·nî lə·šā·rə·ṯê·nî wə·šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- miš·mar·tî
verses.literal: They alone shall enter . . . My sanctuary . . . and draw near to My table to minister before Me They will keep - My charge

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּבוֹאָם֙ אֶֽל־ שַׁעֲרֵי֙ הַפְּנִימִ֔ית הֶחָצֵ֣ר יִלְבָּ֑שׁוּ פִשְׁתִּ֖ים בִּגְדֵ֥י וְלֹֽא־ יַעֲלֶ֤ה עֲלֵיהֶם֙ צֶ֔מֶר בְּשָֽׁרְתָ֗ם בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֛י הַפְּנִימִ֖ית הֶחָצֵ֥ר וָבָֽיְתָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·ḇō·w·’ām ’el- ša·‘ă·rê hap·pə·nî·mîṯ he·ḥā·ṣêr yil·bā·šū p̄iš·tîm biḡ·ḏê wə·lō- ya·‘ă·leh ‘ă·lê·hem ṣe·mer bə·šā·rə·ṯām bə·ša·‘ă·rê hap·pə·nî·mîṯ he·ḥā·ṣêr wā·ḇā·yə·ṯāh
verses.literal: - When they enter . . . the gates of the inner court they are to wear linen garments they must not wear anything made of wool when they minister at the gates of the inner court or inside [the temple]

verses.original: פִשְׁתִּים֙ יִהְי֣וּ פַּאֲרֵ֤י עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֔ם פִשְׁתִּ֔ים יִהְי֖וּ וּמִכְנְסֵ֣י עַל־ מָתְנֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א יַחְגְּר֖וּ בַּיָּֽזַע׃
verses.transliteration: p̄iš·tîm yih·yū pa·’ă·rê ‘al- rō·šām p̄iš·tîm yih·yū ū·miḵ·nə·sê ‘al- mā·ṯə·nê·hem lō yaḥ·gə·rū bay·yā·za‘
verses.literal: They are to wear linen . . . turbans on their heads and linen . . . undergarments around their waists They must not wear anything that makes them perspire

verses.original: וּ֠בְצֵאתָם אֶל־ הַחִיצוֹנָ֜ה הֶחָצֵ֨ר אֶל־ הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַחִיצוֹנָה֮ אֶל־ הָעָם֒ יִפְשְׁט֣וּ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֙מָּה֙ מְשָׁרְתִ֣ם בָּ֔ם וְהִנִּ֥יחוּ אוֹתָ֖ם הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ בְּלִֽשְׁכֹ֣ת וְלָֽבְשׁוּ֙ אֲחֵרִ֔ים בְּגָדִ֣ים וְלֹֽא־ יְקַדְּשׁ֥וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם בְּבִגְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ṣê·ṯām ’el- ha·ḥî·ṣō·w·nāh he·ḥā·ṣêr ’el- he·ḥā·ṣêr ha·ḥî·ṣō·w·nāh ’el- hā·‘ām yip̄·šə·ṭū ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê·hem ’ă·šer- hêm·māh mə·šā·rə·ṯim bām wə·hin·nî·ḥū ’ō·w·ṯām haq·qō·ḏeš bə·liš·ḵōṯ wə·lā·ḇə·šū ’ă·ḥê·rîm bə·ḡā·ḏîm wə·lō- yə·qad·də·šū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām bə·ḇiḡ·ḏê·hem
verses.literal: When they go out to the outer court to . . . . . . . . . the people they are to take off - the garments in which they have ministered leave them in the holy chambers and dress in other clothes so that they do not transmit holiness - to the people with their garments

verses.original: לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֔חוּ וְרֹאשָׁם֙ וּפֶ֖רַע לֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑חוּ כָּס֥וֹם יִכְסְמ֖וּ אֶת־ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō yə·ḡal·lê·ḥū wə·rō·šām ū·p̄e·ra‘ lō yə·šal·lê·ḥū kā·sō·wm yiḵ·sə·mū ’eṯ- rā·šê·hem
verses.literal: They must not shave their heads or let their hair . . . grow long but must carefully trim . . . - their hair

verses.original: לֹֽא־ כֹּהֵ֑ן יִשְׁתּ֖וּ כָּל־ וְיַ֥יִן בְּבוֹאָ֖ם אֶל־ הַפְּנִימִֽית׃ הֶחָצֵ֥ר
verses.transliteration: lō- kō·hên yiš·tū kāl- wə·ya·yin bə·ḇō·w·’ām ’el- hap·pə·nî·mîṯ he·ḥā·ṣêr
verses.literal: No priest may drink . . . wine before he enters . . . the inner court

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִקְח֥וּ לְנָשִׁ֑ים לָהֶ֖ם וְאַלְמָנָה֙ וּגְרוּשָׁ֔ה כִּ֣י אִם־ יִקָּֽחוּ׃ בְּתוּלֹ֗ת מִזֶּ֙רַע֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהָֽאַלְמָנָה֙ אַלְמָנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה מִכֹּהֵ֖ן
verses.transliteration: lō- yiq·ḥū lə·nā·šîm lā·hem wə·’al·mā·nāh ū·ḡə·rū·šāh kî ’im- yiq·qā·ḥū bə·ṯū·lōṯ miz·ze·ra‘ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·hā·’al·mā·nāh ’al·mā·nāh ’ă·šer tih·yeh mik·kō·hên
verses.literal: And they shall not marry . . . a widow or a divorced woman but must marry a virgin of the descendants of the house of Israel . . . or a widow - - of a priest

verses.original: וְאֶת־ יוֹר֔וּ עַמִּ֣י בֵּ֥ין קֹ֖דֶשׁ לְחֹ֑ל יוֹדִעֻֽם׃ וּבֵין־ לְטָה֖וֹר טָמֵ֥א
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- yō·w·rū ‘am·mî bên qō·ḏeš lə·ḥōl yō·w·ḏi·‘um ū·ḇên- lə·ṭā·hō·wr ṭā·mê
verses.literal: - They are to teach My people the difference between the holy and the common and show them how to discern between the clean and the unclean

verses.original: וְעַל־ רִ֗יב הֵ֚מָּה יַעַמְד֣וּ לִשְׁפֹּט וְשָׁפְטֻהוּ בְּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י וְאֶת־ יִשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וְאֶת־ תּוֹרֹתַ֤י וְאֶת־ חֻקֹּתַי֙ בְּכָל־ מוֹעֲדַ֣י שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י יְקַדֵּֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- rîḇ hêm·māh ya·‘am·ḏū liš·pōṭ wə·šå̄·p̄ə·ṭu·hū bə·miš·pā·ṭay wə·’eṯ- yiš·mō·rū wə·’eṯ- tō·w·rō·ṯay wə·’eṯ- ḥuq·qō·ṯay bə·ḵāl mō·w·‘ă·ḏay šab·bə·ṯō·w·ṯay yə·qad·dê·šū
verses.literal: In any dispute they shall officiate as judges [and] judge according to My ordinances They must keep - My laws and statutes regarding all My appointed feasts and they must keep My Sabbaths holy

verses.original: לֹ֥א לְטָמְאָ֑ה יָב֖וֹא וְאֶל־ מֵ֣ת אָדָ֔ם כִּ֣י אִם־ לְאָ֡ב וּ֠לְאֵם וּלְבֵ֨ן וּלְבַ֜ת לְאָ֗ח אֲשֶֽׁר־ לֹא־ הָיְתָ֥ה לְאִ֖ישׁ וּלְאָח֛וֹת יִטַּמָּֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō lə·ṭā·mə·’āh yā·ḇō·w wə·’el- mêṯ ’ā·ḏām kî ’im- lə·’āḇ ū·lə·’êm ū·lə·ḇên ū·lə·ḇaṯ lə·’āḥ ’ă·šer- lō- hā·yə·ṯāh lə·’îš ū·lə·’ā·ḥō·wṯ yiṭ·ṭam·mā·’ū
verses.literal: A priest must not defile himself by going near a dead person However . . . for a father a mother a son a daughter a brother - or an unmarried . . . . . . sister he may do so

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵ֖י טָֽהֳרָת֑וֹ יִסְפְּרוּ־ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê ṭā·ho·rā·ṯōw yis·pə·rū- šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm lōw
verses.literal: and after he is cleansed he must count off seven days for himself

verses.original: וּבְיוֹם֩ בֹּא֨וֹ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ אֶל־ הַפְּנִימִית֙ הֶחָצֵ֤ר לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ יַקְרִ֖יב חַטָּאת֑וֹ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·yō·wm bō·’ōw ’el- haq·qō·ḏeš ’el- hap·pə·nî·mîṯ he·ḥā·ṣêr lə·šā·rêṯ baq·qō·ḏeš yaq·rîḇ ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: And on the day he goes into the sanctuary into the inner court to minister in the sanctuary he must present his sin offering declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לְֽנַחֲלָ֔ה אֲנִ֖י נַֽחֲלָתָ֑ם תִתְּנ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ לֹֽא־ וַאֲחֻזָּ֗ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲנִ֖י אֲחֻזָּתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lā·hem lə·na·ḥă·lāh ’ă·nî na·ḥă·lā·ṯām ṯit·tə·nū lā·hem lō- wa·’ă·ḥuz·zāh bə·yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·nî ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯām
verses.literal: In regard to their inheritance I am their inheritance You are to give them no possession in Israel for I [am] their possession

verses.original: הֵ֖מָּה יֹֽאכְל֑וּם הַמִּנְחָה֙ וְהַחַטָּ֣את וְהָאָשָׁ֔ם וְכָל־ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֵ֥רֶם יִהְיֶֽה׃ לָהֶ֥ם
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh yō·ḵə·lūm ham·min·ḥāh wə·ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·hā·’ā·šām wə·ḵāl bə·yiś·rā·’êl ḥê·rem yih·yeh lā·hem
verses.literal: They shall eat the grain offerings the sin offerings and the guilt offerings Everything in Israel devoted to the LORD will belong to them

verses.original: וְרֵאשִׁית֩ כָּל־ בִּכּ֨וּרֵי כֹ֜ל וְכָל־ תְּר֣וּמַת כֹּ֗ל מִכֹּל֙ תְּרוּמ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם יִֽהְיֶ֑ה לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים תִּתְּנ֣וּ וְרֵאשִׁ֤ית עֲרִסֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן בְּרָכָ֖ה לְהָנִ֥יחַ אֶל־ בֵּיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rê·šîṯ kāl- bik·kū·rê ḵōl wə·ḵāl tə·rū·maṯ kōl mik·kōl tə·rū·mō·w·ṯê·ḵem yih·yeh lak·kō·hă·nîm tit·tə·nū wə·rê·šîṯ ‘ă·ri·sō·w·ṯê·ḵem lak·kō·hên bə·rā·ḵāh lə·hā·nî·aḥ ’el- bê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: The best of all the firstfruits - and of every contribution - from all your offerings will belong to the priests You are to give your first batch of dough to the priest so that a blessing may rest upon your homes

verses.original: הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃פ לֹ֥א יֹאכְל֖וּ כָּל־ הָע֖וֹף וּמִן־ הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה נְבֵלָה֙ וּטְרֵפָ֔ה מִן־
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hă·nîm lō yō·ḵə·lū kāl- hā·‘ō·wp̄ ū·min- hab·bə·hê·māh nə·ḇê·lāh ū·ṭə·rê·p̄āh min-
verses.literal: The priests may not eat any bird . . . or animal found dead or torn [by] [wild] [beasts] . . .
